correctness.rationale: The proof counts all proper completions, shows shorter-blade vertices are never forceable, derives the at-most-one-hole rule on every maximal blade, characterizes hub activation by a complete palette of other colours, and counts precisely the bad missing-colour assignments via s times the product of falling factorials. It supplies necessity, sufficiency, no overcounting, all positive size vectors with at least two blades, the s=1 boundary, and normalization to the probability polynomial. Direct labelled brute-force enumeration of all partial assignments on twenty-one small vectors and an additional exact identity sweep matched the formula; finite checks are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The polynomial enumerates every successful initial local colouring for a natural infinite graph family parametrized by an unrestricted multiset of clique sizes. It simultaneously determines all coefficients, exact forcing minimum and its multiplicity. Its degree-threshold freezing and global hub-colour inclusion-exclusion capture a structural interaction missing from previously solved complete multipartite and maximum-degree-two cases. It does not claim a general block-graph theorem or a paper-scale advance.
